## Featured Architecture: RosettaEdge
- **Showcase Portal**: [RosettaEdge Showcase](https://alexmaina.dev/RosettaEdge/)
- **Technical Documentation**: [RosettaEdge Interactive Docs](https://alexmaina.dev/RosettaEdge/doc/)
- **Academic Monograph (44 Pages, ISO A4)**: [Monografia Tecnica Online](https://alexmaina.dev/RosettaEdge/monografia/) | [Download PDF](https://alexmaina.dev/RosettaEdge/rosettaedge-monografia-tecnica.pdf)
- **Official DOI**: [10.5281/zenodo.23781231](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23781231)
- **Wikidata Entity**: [Q142075894](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q142075894)
- **GitHub Repositories**: [AlexMaina05/RosettaEdge (iOS/watchOS)](https://github.com/AlexMaina05/RosettaEdge) | [AlexMaina05/RosettaEdge-Android](https://github.com/AlexMaina05/RosettaEdge-Android)
- **Core Innovations**:
  - *Zero-Cloud Privacy Paradigm:* 100% on-device processing and cryptographic storage via Apple Secure Enclave and Android KeyStore (Full GDPR Art. 9 & Art. 25 compliance).
  - *Streaming SAX Engine:* Single-pass progressive XML parser with constant memory footprint O(d_max) (~4.2 MB RAM peak), immune to XML entity expansion attacks and OS Jetsam kills.
  - *Identity Firewall:* Deterministic fuzzy demographic matching pipeline (Jaro-Winkler + Levenshtein, 1.8 ms latency) preventing accidental ingestion of family members' lab results.
  - *Dual Semantic Pathway:* Vital signs to Apple HealthKit / Health Connect with UCUM unit conversion; clinical lab chemistry preserved in local encrypted SQLite vaults with full FHIR R4 fidelity.

## Core Technical Projects
- [HP Fortress Hybrid Server](https://mainadev.me/#work): Debian 13 Trixie, Proxmox/Docker virtualization, redundant ZFS storage pool, WireGuard mesh, and reverse proxying with automated SSL.
- [RBAC Security Console](https://mainadev.me/#work): Role-based access control auditing and Entra ID governance tool implementing Least Privilege principles.
- [Officina Control Tower](https://mainadev.me/#work): Automotive workflow tracker and fleet operations platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and SQLite.
- [Forge3D CAD](https://3d-model-tau-ebon.vercel.app/): In-browser parametric 3D CAD modeler built with TypeScript, Replicad, and OpenCascade WebAssembly for 3D printing.

All in-depth tutorials, system administration blueprints, and cloud security guides are indexed on the main engineering hub [alexmaina.dev/guide/](https://alexmaina.dev/guide/):

1. [Caddy Web Server in Docker with Automated SSL](https://alexmaina.dev/caddy-docker-reverse-proxy-ssl/): Declarative reverse proxy with zero-maintenance Let's Encrypt certificates and native WebSocket routing.
2. [Cloudflare Tunnel & Docker Zero Trust](https://alexmaina.dev/cloudflare-tunnel-docker-zero-trust/): Expose self-hosted container services securely to the public WAN without open router ports or CGNAT issues.
3. [Docker Log Rotation with daemon.json](https://alexmaina.dev/docker-log-rotation-daemon-json/): Global daemon configuration preventing disk saturation from runaway json-file logs.
4. [Proxmox VE & ZFS Mirroring for Homelab](https://alexmaina.dev/proxmox-zfs-backup-homelab/): Enterprise storage resilience, deterministic snapshots, remote replication, and 3-2-1 backup strategy.

6. [Resolve AADSTS50011 Redirect URI Mismatch in Entra ID](https://alexmaina.dev/entra-id-redirect-uri-aadsts50011/): OAuth2/OIDC troubleshooting with MSAL, Single Page Apps, PKCE, and localhost configurations.
